data.body: Residual-gap sweep complete. Fixed in scope: added a real git clone --shared oracle for alternates; mutating _has_alternates to return false made it RED (standalone/[] instead of shared/[alternates]), then production was restored. Reuse disposition: _snapshot.cache entry_size/exclusive_size/distinct_bytes are reclamation-coupled logical st_size helpers that deliberately ignore or double-count different hardlink shapes and swallow racing OSErrors; footprint measurement needs one deterministic walk producing pathname-logical bytes plus st_blocks allocation, inode deduplication, and structured unavailable. Keeping the new seam separate avoids coupling capacity reporting to cache-eviction semantics and avoids a second walk. Surface census: CLI is in scope and proven through real subprocesses; internal Python seam is documented below the facade; top-level library and MCP are out of scope because this is an explicit operator diagnostic; automated callers/gates/schedulers are out of scope by operator decision; reverse/dual-direction is not applicable to a read-only measurement. No deferred test exclusion remains. Final post-upstream checks: lint GREEN, typecheck GREEN, generated help/reference GREEN, 67 focused plus new-upstream tests passed; plan attestation remains certified.
